note: Late night came back from summer break into a huge news week: Sen. Lindsey Graham died suddenly on July 11, and Sen. Mitch McConnell released his first health update since his June hospitalization — nearly every host built their monologue around one or both. Fallon and Seth Meyers both returned from multi-week hiatuses; Ike Barinholtz is guest-hosting Kimmel's slot all week (his first time). Checked Gutfeld! too, but Greg was off this week (Tyrus filled in) and no solid quotable lines surfaced from the panel.

jokes.topic: The Pentagon's latest UFO file release, cut against McConnell's hospital "proof of life" photo
jokes.joke: There weren't many clear images or footage released — except for a clear image of an alien they found in Kentucky.
jokes.context: Cut to McConnell's hospital photo, which Barinholtz called a "jump-scare."

jokes.topic: Sen. Lindsey Graham's sister being sworn in as his Senate replacement
jokes.joke: The big political story today is that we officially have a replacement for Lindsey Graham in the Senate — it's Lindsey Graham's sister, which is very confusing because I always thought Lindsey Graham was Lindsey Graham's sister.

jokes.topic: Trump's stalled Iran war claims resurfacing amid the Epstein files controversy
jokes.joke: I still don't understand why he even started this war.
jokes.context: Launched into a mock coughing fit before adding, "Jeffrey Epstein was his best friend for many, many years."

jokes.topic: Riffing on the stages of grief around Graham's death and McConnell's health
jokes.joke: We all grieve in different ways. You know, there's stages to grief. It's denial, anger, spacing out, pissing yourself, forgetting what you were talking about, and then changing the subject completely.

jokes.topic: McConnell's first health update since his June hospitalization
jokes.joke: I'm not sure how OK he is because that's actually a video. ... Looks like a husband and wife ventriloquist act.
jokes.context: The photo showed McConnell seated, appearing to be physically supported by his wife Elaine Chao; Fallon also cracked, "Nothing says perfect health like having someone hold you up when you're already sitting."

jokes.joke: Mitch said, 'I'm feeling great and I'll be back at work by August 1997.'

jokes.topic: Trump's eulogy-style comments about Lindsey Graham
jokes.joke: What a touching tribute. ... Very rare for the person giving the eulogy to say, 'I wish I'd talked to him less.'
jokes.context: Meyers' first show back after a three-week summer break; he also retired his long-running "Mee-Maw" bit, an imaginary disapproving grandmother character built around Graham over the years.

jokes.topic: Trump's Fox & Friends comments about Graham calling him "all the time"
jokes.joke: I'll never forget the way that I always let him go to voicemail. It was our thing.
jokes.context: Mimicking Trump after playing a clip where Trump said of Graham, "I'd say, 'Stop calling me, Lindsey.'"

jokes.topic: Trump giving Graham's life a numerical "score" during his tribute
jokes.joke: The president has zoomed through the first five stages of grief and gone straight to number six: f--- that guy.
jokes.context: On Trump rating Graham "99 out of 100": "My favorite part of any eulogy is when they announce the person's life score. He's doing a eulogy like it's Portnoy doing a pizza review."
